args: For budget buddy, when I go add budget from the master page. If I close one of the dropdowns by clicking on the dropdown again rather than selecting an option, it closes the whole model. The modal is not usable on mobile because it doesn't scroll. And can we have, across the app, that dropdowns are alphabetically sorted and have a search bar in them?
